summary: Iter 215ay — Phase 3 CRM rebrand Pulse-leakage critical bug fix VERIFIED. Backend /api/crm/auth/login and /api/crm/auth/me now correctly return crm_brand, is_pulse_internal, and is_master_admin fields. Pulse-branded users (craig.henshall@pulsefitness.com) now see Pulse cyan branding inside CRM, NOT GymAxis purple gradient. All critical tests PASSED.

issues: Demo tour modal shows 'Welcome to GymAxis CRM' for all users including Pulse-branded users. Consider making this brand-aware.

rca_of_the_issue.bug: Pulse-branded CRM users were seeing GymAxis branding (FIXED)
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The /api/crm/auth/login endpoint was not returning crm_brand field in the response. The field was computed in _resolve_crm_brand_flags() but only used in the cross-login flow.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Lines 167-204 in /app/backend/routes/crm_auth.py now call _resolve_crm_brand_flags() and include crm_brand, is_pulse_internal, is_master_admin in the login response. Lines 214-227 do the same for /me endpoint.
rca_of_the_issue.verification: Curl tests confirm crm_brand='pulse' for Pulse users and crm_brand='gymaxis' for GymAxis users. Frontend correctly renders Pulse branding (cyan, no gradient) for Pulse users.
